header_sentences: See Internal man, Lot (the man), and Natural.

contexts.text: The external man himself is called the dry land, and presently earth.
See Creep.
Thus regeneration begins from the external man, and proceeds to the internal. AC 64.
Man was made a living soul = that the external man also was made living.

It here treats of the life of the external man; in the two former verses, of the life of his faith... in this one, of the life of his love. Before, the external man did not want to obey and serve the internal, but continually fought against him; and therefore the external man was not then man. But now, when he is made celestial, the external man begins to serve the internal, and also becomes man; and, in fact, through the life of faith and the life of love. The life of faith prepares him, the life of love makes him man. Illustrated. External men know of scarcely anything but knowledge, which they call intelligence and wisdom, and also faith; they do not even know what love is...
Bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh = the proprium of the external man...
Ground = the external man... It is the external man, that is, his affection and memory, in which are implanted the seeds of good and truth... AC 990:end.
The Rational also belongs to the external man, being in itself a kind of medium between the internal and the external man...
To return to the ground from which he was taken = that the Church would return to the external man such as he was before regeneration.
The earth, here, = nothing else than the external man.
Spirits constitute the external man (of the Grand Man).

The fructification of good and the multiplication of truth take place in the external man; the former in his affections, the latter in his memory. The external man is here called the earth into which they spread themselves, and upon which they fructify and multiply themselves.
He comes into straitnesses and temptations, until he is reduced into such a state, that the external man becomes compliant to the internal...
(Thus) man's thought is not of the internal, but of the external man.
See Body.
To replenish the earth = with the external man. Explained. AC 1016.
In the external man there are recipient vessels, which are called those of the memory, which are formed by means of Knowledges... according to the influx of the internal man.
(Thus) with the Lord, equally as with other men, there was, in childhood, a scarcity of Knowledges in His external man. AC 1464, Signified.

The external man can only be reduced to correspondence with the internal man by means of Knowledges. The external man is corporeal and sensuous, and does not receive anything celestial and spiritual unless Knowledges are implanted in it as in their ground... AC 1487.
His external man also was made Divine. AC 1489:end.
This food... is communicated to the external man, to the end that the external man may be adapted to the internal.
All things whatever in the external man are mere things of service... to the internal man. Signified.
By means of scientifics to build up the external man...

In () it treats of the external man with the Lord, which was to be conjoined with His internal man. The external man is the Human essence; the internal man is the Divine essence. The former is represented by Lot; the latter by Abram.
There is here described the state of His external man as it was in childhood...
That there were still many things in His external man which hindered conjunction. Treated of.
There appeared to the Lord the external man as he is in his beauty when conjoined with the internal man; and also as he is when not conjoined. Treated of.
A promise that when the external man was conjoined with the internal, or the Human essence with the Divine one, all power would be given to Him. Treated of.

The external man receives his life principally from the internal man, that is, from the spirit or soul... But this life cannot be received by the external man particularly or distinctly, unless his organic vessels are opened... These are opened through the medium of the senses by means of scientifics and Knowledges, and also by means of pleasures and delights... Therefore it must needs be that scientifics and Knowledges will insinuate themselves into the external man which cannot agree with spiritual truths; and pleasures and delights which cannot agree with celestial goods... and when these things are regarded as ends they draw the external man outwards and downwards... And therefore unless such things are first dispersed, the internal man cannot possibly agree with the external man. (Signified by the separation of Lot from Abram.)
The things with which the external man abounds. Signified.
There are two kinds of things in the external man; those which can agree with the internal man, and those which cannot. (The latter are here sig.) AC 1568.
There are in the external man many things with which the internal man can dwell; as affections of good and the delights and pleasures thence originating...
But there are also many things in the external man which do not agree... as all things which spring from the love of self and the love of the world...

In order to know what effects the correspondence and agreement of the external man with the internal, and what effects disagreement, it is merely necessary to reflect upon the ends which reign, or, what is the same, upon the loves which reign...
The things in the external man which agree are from the internal man, that is, through the internal man from the Lord...
The Canaanite and the Perizzite were then dwelling in the Land = the (hereditary) evils and falsities in the external man.
The things which agree are Abram, even those which are in the external man; for these constitute one thing with the internal man, and belong to it.
With the external man everything is natural; for the external man himself is the same as the natural man...
As in the internal man there are two principles, the celestial and the Spiritual... so in the external man; his Celestial is called natural good; and his Spiritual, natural truth.

The evil which is in the external man cannot be separated in any man, except in the Lord... When it thus becomes quiescent, then for the first time goods flow in from the Lord, and affect the external man...
The external man enlightened by the internal. Signified.
The Lord, when a child, was often in such Divine vision as to His external man, because He alone was to conjoin the external man with the internal...
He saw all the plain of Jordan = those goods and truths which were in the external man.
The things at the boundaries of Canaan represented the external man. Illustrated.

Before Jehovah destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah = the external man destroyed by cupidities of evil and persuasions of falsity... For these two things are what destroy the external man, and separate it from the internal. Explained.
The Rational is the intelligence of the external man.
There are three things which constitute the external man; the Rational, the Scientific, and the external Sensuous...
Nothing lives in the external man except affection. Explained.
The good of love continually inflows through the internal man into the external man; but if a man is in the affection of evil he perverts this good...

The nature of the beauty of the external man when conjoined with the internal cannot be described, because it does not exist with any man, but only with the Lord... The three Heavens are images of the Lord's external man...
The ugliness of the external man when disjoined from the internal, is described in these three verses. AC 1593.
Regarded in himself, the external man is a mere instrument to serve the internal man... AC 1603.
The Lord became life as to the external man also.
His Human essence or external man is that which is called the Son of Man. See AC 1733:2.
It was the goods and truths in the external man... from which the Lord in His childhood fought against evils and falsities. AC 1655. AC 1660. AC 1661:5.
Came Chedorlaomer = apparent good in the external man.
The goods in the external man now delivered from the yoke of slavery. Signified.
All things in the external man, before it is delivered, are called servants.
That the interior man reduced all things in the external man into a state of agreement. Signified.

It is supposed that the things of the body alone constitute the external man... but these constitute the outermost man, which is merely corporeal. The external man is properly constituted of the scientifics which are of the memory, and the affections which are of love with which the man is imbued; and also the sensuous things which are proper to the spirit, together with the pleasures which also belong to the spirit.
Under Valley, see this reference.
Who brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees = the first state of the external man.
When He had completely expelled the evils of the external man. Signified.
Under Herd, see this reference.
Under Correspond, see this reference.
Under Vessel, see this reference.
Jacob = the Lord's external man.
See Delight. AC 3952:4.
This conjunction cannot come forth until the natural or external man has been prepared. Explained.
The spirit, when loosed from the body, has in it all things which are of the external man, except the flesh and bones.

So long as a man is in the external man, as all are at the beginning of reformation, he cannot but think so, since he thinks only from the external man. But when the external man with its concupiscences is removed...
Divine truth can be received even by the evil, but only by their external man. AC 4180:4.
The Societies of Spirits and Angels to which correspond the things which are of the external man, as to a great part are from this Earth.
Pledges of the conjunction of the external man. Signified.
The truth of faith is then only in the external man.
The Natural is the same as the external man.
Things implanted in compulsion remain in the external man.
Servant = the Natural as to truth; and maidservant, the Natural as to good, both in the external man.
They are merely external men. AC 10067:end.

In order to be regenerate the external or natural man must be reduced to compliance... Man is not regenerate until his external man is regenerate. And the external man is regenerated through the internal by the Lord. References.
When the internal of man is being regenerated, the scientifics and truths of the external man are like the fibres of fruit, through which the juice is carried to the internal...
Under Bullock, see this reference. AC 9670:6. AC 9990. AC 10021. AC 10035.
See She-goat.
Under Goat, see this reference.
On the internal and external man. General article. NJHD 36.
Under Good, see this reference.
Under Fig, see this reference.
A cake not turned exists when the external man reigns over the internal.
What is celestial in the external man. Signified.
See Divine Good.
With the regenerate, conjunction is effected in the external man. Signified.
Under Evening, see this reference.
The external man is first imbued with truths, and then the interior man successively.
To make the Sons of Israel go up from the land of Egypt = elevation from the external man to the internal.
While man lives in the world he thinks in the external man, and not perceptibly in the internal until he comes into the other life.
Man is to remove evils in the external man as of himself. General article. DP 112. DP 114. DP 116. DP 123:4. DP 233:9.
The love of the sex is of the external man, and is therefore common to every animal. Explained.

The Lord... put on the Divine Natural, and from this He enlightens not only the internal spiritual man, but also the external natural man. Unless both these are enlightened together, the man is as it were in shade...
When anyone there commits anything to paper from the external man only... it is obliterated of itself.
(Charles XII) let into the state of his external man.
